comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Asset-light online two-sided marketplace earning take-rate fees from consumer-facing local service bookings; closest business model, though home services rather than lodging.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Owns luxury hotel real estate as a REIT; capital-intensive asset owner, unlike Airbnb's asset-light commission marketplace.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: B2B travel distribution and airline IT software sold to suppliers and agencies, not a consumer lodging marketplace.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Owns select-service hotels as a REIT; asset-heavy room revenue, unlike Airbnb's commission-based platform.
